comments.value:
I don't think breaking through into the content creation rank would take that long? I may be wrong, but I assume most people don't 'start' VRChat because of the ability to create content. They would explore a bit, get used to the world, and maybe make some friends. By the time they are inspired to create their own avatars or world, they would probably have met the rank requirement.

On the other hand, malicious users who make toxic content... If banned, they make new accounts and create more! Then I see how no ranking system would be beneficial to them.

@{5ba474be299aa677a97a5119|full_name}: There isn't the only true way to get into the game. Some people will start like you said, some not. In any case every new player right now is treated badly and will have only negative experiences about the game. If you start playing a game and have experiences like that then it's high probability you will resign and won't play again (it's basic psychology). 

In my case I was invited by a friend for her vrchat wedding, I prepared avatar, but I couldn't upload it. I was super dissapointed, it was really important to me to have my own avatar on her wedding and I felt in this game like intruder rather than wanted new player. I couldn't just start it and fully enjoy the game. For a long time I was that sad and angry I wasn't able even play again. Now I know that I will abandon (and won't miss) VRChat when there will be some other similar game out there and I don't think I'm the only one with similar thougths and feelings, but you just choose to hush us down and pretend everything is all right when there is clearly a problem. :( 

We - players - should be treated like important part of the game. After all we are creating all content and making the game worth playing. We are not enemies. This new system is a joke. I don't want to be part of it and I'm sure none of my friends want it. We are talking about it not because we are evil, but because we want to warn about great mistake VRChat makers are going to make.

As someone whose already witnessed visitors getting shat on just for their rank, I agree with this. Giving people the ability to pretty much ignore new players and pretend like they don't exist with the safety features is a bad idea.

@{5b24556a806f5c0ad5106acf|full_name}: What you said make sense, but I still stand by what I said.  I try to be open minded and look at the big picture. For you, a creative player, the new system seems to discriminate (and it does with the initial content gating). But for every new person like you who play vrchat for the content creation and cannot survive with just the social aspect, dozens of malicious users could be crashing others such as yourself and stealing avatars you work so hard on. This is not to say this system will prevent all this, but it is surely striving to do so. To work towards this at the cost of new players not being able to create content for a few weeks (if at that), I support.
Basically, what you said is in no way wrong, but I was replying in a perspective that strives for a 'better' community.
For newer players out there, this is a glimpse of what I've seen on bad times... Every other public world I join would have stuff like annoying particle, obnoxious sound, crashing particles, avatar stealing, pornography, gore, scat, etc. Or maybe I'm the only one who finds any of this annoying and/or disturbing?  :/

@{5ba474be299aa677a97a5119|full_name}: 
>new players not being able to create content for a few weeks 

That's just too long. Caste system is just a such Orwellian dystopia.

Game needs optimization, sane limits for materials, particles, tessellation, LODs, multithreaded support (90% of my CPU is idle, 50% GPU is idle and I get 15 frames - ridiculous) and most importantly - REASON NOT TO CRASH OTHERS.

There is just not much to do here, if you don't have a circle of friends to play with. And you cannot even do a nice first impression because you can't upload your own stuff.

Look at Space Engineers - they have full C# scripting for their computer blocks and nothing bad happens. Why map makers cannot script to hell and back? Just blocks some system namespaces!

Why can't the integrate chromium engine for webpanels, why do they have to reinvent the nonworking wheel to play youtube? I don't remember time when livestreaming worked for me, it just doesn't.

I'm ranting here but this caste system is last straw, VRChat will kill itself if they shun away new players actively like that.

First you have to wait for a unknown time to upload, then you want to show off your cool shaders and particle animations and get ignored - because nobody will see it on default setting. 

VRChat needs in game profiling and avatar render time limiters, so you can check who is lagging you, and lots and lots optimization, not spend half a year on a reinventing a wheel - scripting system.

comments.mergedPostDetails: Sectioning people into groups inst healthy, its bad enough new users cant upload avatars until they have played the game for a certain amount of time. though, this is a problem in of itself since the game allows you to be a pseudo-developer. How about instead of this overcomplicated system we just get specific options to negate things we don't want to see in public. Blocking avatar particles, shaders, lights sources, sounds, and with options for excluding friends for each category. Simple and more intuitive. The system proposed will make people feel lesser to one another who aren't a higher rank. I can't really express my concern enough for how negative of an update this can be. Imagine how a new player would feel being blocked by all above ranks. I'd wager a lot of the older players might just outright default the visitor and new user ranks as being possible trolls or hackers and just turn all their options off. Why inst more important improvement to the game security being looked into to stopping external programs such as the add-on hack menus script kiddies use to steal avatars and crash worlds, cache rippers, flying etc. Some transparency would be nice.

comments.value: no its not, hackers and trolls wont get high ranks, which means you can block that stuff. low rank people can still interact with others, but its peoples choices if they want to see their stuff or not, it will seperate hackers from actual people that make good models and if you are let's say a "User" you will try to advance to the next rank and if you don't do bad stuff, you will get there!

@{5adfb105f4f7d975b2df5dd5|full_name}: 
>hackers and trolls wont get high ranks

I don't believe so, troll groups will find out how the system works and they will definitely cheat it.

Security by obscurity is a mistake.

Its the worst idea and they need to get rid of it at once. They took away veteran but left the others. Just get rid of it, we had a canny running above 150+ upvotes and it got closed. Just get rid of it!!!

details:
All this will only create caste system and shun away new players, who could do something creative but cannot even upload anything. They will feel left out and ghosted.

Nobody will join VRChat community if you are shunned for being visitor, the player count will dwindle...

You need to encourage new players to create not discourage them. The system which was created to disrupt malicious players doesn't stop them at all, but only discourage new players to play.

Although safety system is a good idea generally - but blocking most of the content for everyone is a really bad idea. Why would I take my time to create a cool shader if nobody is gonna see it?

Take on the real issues @VRPill, like optimisation and stop discouraging creativity.
title: Ranking system is a bad idea
